purpose: Exercise a candidate-pool size-matched random-removal control on the disjoint development victim before freezing confirmation.

candidate_random_removal.population: the frozen detector-eligible target-class candidate positions, including every poison record
candidate_random_removal.size: exactly the number removed by the corresponding detector

retraining.architecture_optimizer_epochs_batch_size: identical to the source victim protocol
retraining.initialization_seed: same victim seed as every other post-filter condition

interpretation.role: fairness control for the eligible candidate universe; it supplements rather than replaces the previously frozen whole-population random-removal baseline
